items.html: *The reason that now two complete posteriors were made for them was in this manner: Through Mitzvot and good deeds of the lower Adam, he caused an upper coupling in AVI, and they returned to give them, to ZON, other Mochin, which are the Hassadim and Gevurot of Daat of ZA, and this is the essential drop that AVI give in their coupling. The reason is that the lights of two Mochin of ZA, called HB, do not appear in ZA since they are clothed in the Netzah Hod of Ima, and only a diminished illumination emerges from hem by the striking of revealed lights of Hassadim that strike them and elicit a little bit of illumination from them outward. It is not so in Hassadim and Gevurot that clothe inside Yesod of Ima which ends at the Chazeh of ZA, and from there they appear in complete disclosure, exit into ZA, and shine in it. For this reason, the most important are the Hassadim and Gevurot.
